question: (1)/(30) { is what percentage of } (2)/(70)? ({Round off the answer to two decimal places.})
solution:
[IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/ca81259519cadfb2d5350673c220e419e60378e9770ad26512fc8e826a8d93f1.png] __Shortcut Trick__

Required % = (1/30) ÷ (2/70) × 100

⇒ (1/30) × (70/2) × 100

⇒ (7/6) × 100 = 116.666...%

⇒ Rounded off = 116.67%

**∴ The correct answer is 116.67%.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/c76c13ba2d2ab46b47f8a931ae621dac081a0cb266b142dc23f58659fac4a466.png] **__Alternate Method__**

**Given:**

Target value = 1/30

Base value = 2/70 = 1/35

**Formula Used:**

Percentage = (Target Value ÷ Base Value) × 100

 Percentage Comparison 
• 100% Mark Base Value: 2/70 (or 1/35) 100% Target Value: 1/30 116.67% Result: 1/30 is 116.67% of 2/70 

**Calculations:**

⇒ Percentage = (1/30) ÷ (1/35) × 100

⇒ Percentage = (1/30) × 35 × 100

⇒ Percentage = (35/30) × 100

⇒ Percentage = (7/6) × 100

⇒ Percentage = 700 ÷ 6 = 116.666... %

⇒ Rounding off to two decimal places, we get 116.67%

**∴ The correct answer is 116.67%.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **__Additional Information__**

Percentage Formula

To find what percentage quantity X is of quantity Y, always use the formula: (X ÷ Y) × 100.

Base Reference Identification

The value following the word 'of' is typically taken as the base (denominator). In this case, 'of 2/70' makes 2/70 the primary reference or base value.

Converting Improper Fractions

An improper fraction (where numerator > denominator) will always yield a percentage greater than 100%. Here, 7/6 equals 1 + 1/6, which directly translates to 100% + 16.67% = 116.67%.
